chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from 'Abdullah ibn 'Amir, from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadhala ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Harith ibn al-Mughira and 'Umar ibn Hanzala and Mansur ibn Hazim — they said: We used to estimate the sun at al-Madina by the cubit (shadow). So he said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Shall I not inform you of something clearer than this? When the sun declines, the time of Zuhr has entered, except that before it there is an optional prayer (subha), and that is up to you — if you wish, you prolong it, and if you wish, you shorten it.'

And Sa'd narrated from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Harith ibn al-Mughira al-Nadhri and 'Umar ibn Hanzala, from Mansur — similar to it, and in it: 'It is up to you. If you have lightened your optional prayer (subha), then (begin Zuhr) when you finish your optional prayer; and if you have prolonged it, then (begin Zuhr) when you finish your optional prayer.'

key_terms.الذراع: Cubit — a unit of measurement (the length from elbow to fingertip) used to estimate shadow length as a means of determining prayer times.
key_terms.السبحة: Subha — the optional (nawafil) prayer performed before the obligatory Zuhr. The term derives from the root meaning 'to glorify God.'
key_terms.زوال الشمس: Solar declination — the moment when the sun passes its zenith and begins its descent. This marks the entry of Zuhr time.

ai.seo_question: When does the time for Zuhr prayer begin according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides a definitive ruling on the entry time for the Zuhr (noon) prayer. Rather than the customary practice of measuring the sun's shadow in cubits — a method used by his companions in Madina — the Imam establishes that the simple declination of the sun from its zenith marks the onset of Zuhr time. He also clarifies the relationship between the Zuhr time and the pre-Zuhr optional prayer (subha/nawafil), noting that while Zuhr time technically begins at solar declination, one may first complete the optional prayer at whatever length one desires before beginning the obligatory Zuhr. A supporting narration through an alternate chain confirms this ruling with a slight elaboration.
